user.title: Set up Synology cards
user.description:
Cards use your existing [Synology DSM integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/synology_dsm/).

Enable Docker cards only if you have configured the built-in [Portainer integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/portainer/). Leave this off to load only NAS overview, storage and a dashboard without Docker tabs or settings.

Select the Synology Portainer endpoint in the card editor after setup. Reload your browser after setup or changing this option.

init.title: Optional Docker support
init.description:
Enable Docker cards only when the built-in [Portainer integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/portainer/) is configured. When disabled, the Docker card, dashboard tab, endpoint selector and container settings are not loaded.

Reload your browser after saving. Existing standalone Docker cards must be removed from dashboards if you disable support; they are not deleted automatically.
